summary: Httpapi plugins moved to Galaxy collections and come with pip installs of Ansible 2.10+. List them with ansible-doc -t httpapi -l.
questions: How do I list available httpapi plugins?
Are httpapi plugins still in ansible-core?

answer_card.title: Viewing httpapi plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Httpapi plugins now live in collections on Ansible Galaxy, and pip installs of 2.10+ include several.

```shell
ansible-doc -t httpapi -l
ansible-doc -t httpapi <plugin name>
```
